blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine women’s football team ended its campaign in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after being dealt a 4-0 defeat by host Japan on Friday at Shizuoka Stadium in Fukuroi. It took just two minutes for the Filipinas to go behind after conceding the opener, before Japan scored its other three goals in the first half, which ended the competitive phase of the match. Mami Ueno doubled the lead in the 26th, Saori Takarada made it 3-0 in the 36th before Chiina Kamiya added another before the halftime […]...
